static_traits.name: 安东
static_traits.family_status: Both parents serve in the military
static_traits.social_status: 与Female友居住在盐湖城；养有两只比格犬（Chance与Boomer）；有一定社会支持但难以与亲密关系对象讨论对蜘蛛的恐惧
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；此前not yet针对该恐惧接受治疗或咨询
static_traits.language_features: 自我贬责与负性标签明显（“愚蠢”“失败者”“not够Male人”）；态度偏消极与怀疑；表达具体、逻辑清晰，能描述恐惧影响；配合度Average，愿意尝试记录想法；存在回避倾向与羞耻感

basic_info.main_problem: I am afraid of spiders; this fear makes me feel like a failure and ridiculous.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because the fear of spiders began to affect my daily life and cause distress.
growth_experiences: 童年时期经历过一次与蜘蛛相关的事件，受到严重惊吓；虽not记得全部细节，但从那之后对蜘蛛一直极度恐惧，该问题长期存在并逐渐加重。

core_beliefs: 我很软弱，without法控制自己的恐惧

special_situations.event: 在家中看到或得知有蜘蛛出现
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在家里遇到蜘蛛，我会失去控制，without法自我调节
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 立刻逃避现场、加强检查和警觉、避免在可能有蜘蛛的房间逗留，甚至without法入睡
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我可能会崩溃/失控，整晚都cannot sleep

special_situations.event: Knows there are spiders nearby at the workplace (flight-related environment)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果工作环境有蜘蛛，我将without法专注并可能影响工作安全与表现
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding work areas, getting distracted, trying detours or delaying tasks to avoid contact with spiders
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会搞砸工作，情况可能很严重

special_situations.event: 与Female友发生争执（她认为我反应过度）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现出恐惧，他人会看not起我，说明我not够Male人、not用
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces communication on related topics, avoids activities or places where spiders may appear, to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她觉得我很可笑/not用，关系会因此变糟

special_situations.event: 与他人比较（认为do not人都能处理蜘蛛而自己not行）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能像do not人那样应对蜘蛛，就证明I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-denial、加剧自我批评与羞耻，进一步回避可能出现蜘蛛的环境
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 只有我做not到，I am not as good as others

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and accepted, seen as someone strong who can master fear
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失控、被嘲笑或被贬低为“失败者/not够Male人”，担心关系受损
defense_goal: 通过回避与Self-denial来降低外界评价的威胁，维持表面安全与控制感

object_relations.self_representation: 羞耻、软弱、易失控的失败者自我
object_relations.object_representation: 批判且not理解的他者（以伴侣为主），可能会看not起自己

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to discuss or face the fear of spiders (such as the counselor suggesting exploration and exposure)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes change is hard and the fear is deeply rooted, worried they will lose control or be proven 'very weak'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone is gentle and empathic, acknowledge the reasonableness of their worries; use questions of concretization and small-step advancement, avoid confrontation, invite them to describe a mildest fear situation and assess a bearable attempt.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在亲密关系中被认为“反应过度”或被暗示“not够Male人”
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将外部评价内化为对自我的全面negate，认为问题在于自己本身“without用”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 采用支持性语气，识do not并标注自我攻击的语言；以温和反问区分事实与评价，鼓励其描述具体事件与影响，逐步重建更平衡的自我表述。

manifestations: Fear limits choices and actions (avoids places and activities)
在工作场合因恐惧without法专注、需要绕行或延迟任务
难以在亲密关系中Freedom表达与讨论恐惧
觉得“只有自己not能应对”，When comparing oneself with others感到自卑与孤立
难以与Female友或支持系统讨论恐惧，担心被看not起

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 以“do not人都能应对、我也应该能”为标准衡量自己
用“失败者”“not够Male人”等社会化标签评价自我

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: In sessions, expresses doubt and reservation, worrying that trying will prove one 'very weak'

positive_force: Willing to seek help and start counseling，具备一定的改变动机
能清晰描述trigger情境与影响，具备自我观察基础
拥有一定社会支持（Female友、宠物）尽管目前难以讨论恐惧
negative_force: 长期回避与警觉Reinforcement了恐惧反应
自我标签化与羞耻感显著，降低Self-efficacy
A cognitive tendency toward catastrophizing and predicting the future增强Anxiety
Comparison with others leads to inferiority and isolation, hindering support-seeking

target_behavior.behavior: 对蜘蛛的强烈恐惧与回避（伴随惊恐反应与insomnia）
antecedent: 仅仅想到或得知环境中有蜘蛛
在家中出现蜘蛛或被告知曾出现蜘蛛
在工作场所知晓可能有蜘蛛
target_behavior.core_reason: 童年时期的与蜘蛛相关的创伤性经历Reinforcement了对蜘蛛的危险解释，并发展为灾难化与失控的认知
target_behavior.function: Avoids fear and potential danger to gain immediate safety and emotional relief
target_behavior.consequence: 工作专注与表现受损；Strained intimate relationships与争执；日常活动中断与范围缩小；难以入睡、疲惫增加
